name: Sandbox Corvette
role: Juice sandbox target: the Earth corvette (Warden class, 374 m) on a corvette-class flight model.

topSpeed.source: FS2 design appendix (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-monolith-vertical-slice-design.md, flight table): corvette 30-35 m/s

reverseSpeed.source: FS2 design appendix (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-monolith-vertical-slice-design.md, flight table): capital ships have no reverse in the slice

rotationTime.source: FS2 design appendix (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-monolith-vertical-slice-design.md, flight table): corvette turn 100 s (roll 70-80)

rotDamp.source: FS2 design appendix (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-monolith-vertical-slice-design.md, flight table): corvette rot damp 1-2 s

sideDamp.source: Estimate: capital ships do not slide in FS2 (side damping is not in the appendix); set equal to the turn damping

forwardAccel.source: FS2 design appendix (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-monolith-vertical-slice-design.md, flight table): corvette accel 8 s

forwardDecel.source: FS2 design appendix (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-monolith-vertical-slice-design.md, flight table): corvette decel 4 s

afterburner.source: FS2 design appendix (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-monolith-vertical-slice-design.md, flight table): capital ships have no afterburner

mass.source: Estimate (FS2 takes mass from the 3D model); only scales how hard knocks shove the ship
